verdict.rationale: CloudConvert's own API v2 docs say official SDKs are available for PHP, Node.js, Python, Ruby, Java and .NET, which covers the mainstream languages and implies the vendor provides them. That evidence is a single documentation line with no detail on releases or upkeep. Missing for 10: evidence of SDK versioning and release cadence, evidence of active vendor maintenance (e.g., repos or changelogs), independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
